0022600177.text: The Knicks (3-4, 8th in the East, on a one-game win streak) host the Chicago Bulls (1-6, 13th in the East, on a five-game losing streak) in their eighth game of the season. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Jalen Smith is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision. New York leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 133-127 win in Chicago on October 28, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
